result.summary: FAIL on one finding (F-1, major, not blocking); every flow works. Stand: fresh clone at 5f229ba in <scratch>, npm ci, node server/node-main.js with PORT=0, in-memory PGlite, fresh SECRET_PEPPER and SETUP_TOKEN_HASH (app/scripts/setup-token.js); three stands one after another, each stopped by its exact pid. Real Chrome 157 headless, one browser, fresh profile, DevTools protocol; ru and en, 390x844 light and 1470x784 dark. S1 setup 201 and the done line: PASS. S2 second setup: POST /api/auth/setup 404 {"error":"not_found"}, byte-equal to an admin route and an unknown route without a session, page text «Page not found.»: PASS. S3 wrong password 401 invalid_credentials with the plain message, right password 200, reload keeps the session, cookie sai_s HttpOnly SameSite=Lax: PASS. S4 TOTP enrolment: key (32 base32) and otpauth address shown as text, wrong code 401 totp_invalid, computed RFC 6238 code confirmed 200, 10 backup codes, key emptied: PASS (layout F-1 at 390). S5 logout 200, reload shows the form, me 401, no cookie: PASS. S6 login asks for the code (401 totp_required, the code field appears), code 200: PASS. S7 reset link issued by the admin (reauth 200, reset-link 200, form /reset.html#c=<22>), fragment cleared, reset 200, second use 400 reset_invalid with the plain message, old session ended, old password refused, new password + code signs in: PASS. S8 lockout: 5 x 401 then 429 locked «Слишком много неудачных попыток. Попробуйте позже.» / en «Too many failed attempts. Try again later.»: PASS. S9 the admin is not locked: second wrong password 429 rate_limited «Too many requests. Try again later.»: PASS. All 37 snapshots: no horizontal scroll of the document, no code word, ru Cyrillic / en none. Console: no script error; every line is Chrome «Failed to load resource» of a declared refusal (one 403 csrf_refused retried by design, M-2). Record: docs/uat/M2AUTH-20261123-01.md.

issues.text: No scenario file of BA-ANALYST exists for this run; the scenarios are those of the handoff task with REQ-114 and the code design 4.4, 4.9, 5. BA-ANALYST signs the result.

The lockout of an ordinary account was not carried out: M2.2 has no way to create one (invites are REQ-116). The message was shown for an e-mail without an account, which the design 4.9.5 puts under the same rule.

Remarks M-1..M-7 of the record (browser console lines of declared refusals; one csrf_refused retry on reset.html with a session present; the setup code shown in clear text; the code prompt shown under «ERROR»; __Host- cookie is a post-deploy check; Windows stop by pid is immediate; one X3 step not counted). Not failures (AP-117).
